Bulk Delete VPN Credentials
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/vpnCredentials/bulkDelete

Bulk delete VPN credentials up to a maximum of 100 credentials per request. The response returns the VPN IDs that were successfully deleted.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The VPN IDs to bulk delete

ids
int32[]
Responses
​
204
404

Successful Operation
